why: The definitions agree: B, which says the blind transcription IsPSBCoveringB A holds iff A is the object map of a functor with the project's IsProperStrongBundleCovering, is proved. The differences are only presentational. (a) B reads 'strong bundle map A with Q∘A = F∘P' as the project's IsMap (Def. 8.3.2), while the project takes a strong bundle functor (Def. 8.3.3); the non-item IsMap.liftFunctor, isStrongBundleFunctor_liftFunctor and IsStrongBundleFunctor.isMap convert. (b) B requires U open in the local isomorphisms, U(y) open in (2) and F⁻¹(x) finite; the project omits these, but openness follows from IsStrongBundleIsoOn (its base map is an sc-diffeomorphism on U) and finiteness from IsProperCovering. (c) In (3), B quantifies over the smoothness proofs and paracompactness instances that the project fixes. All of these are Props, so the two strong bundle isomorphisms coincide by proof irrelevance, and B's liftB F is definitionally fibredLift P F. Of A's five theorems, A_to_B uses only isScSmoothMap_fibredSnd, for the smoothness of pr₂. A's theorems are helper/non-vacuity facts (pr₂ smooth, two rfl lemmas for 𝐕 ₛ×_A W, the identity and the trivial bundle ℝⁿ×ℝᵏ → ℝⁿ are proper strong bundle coverings). A definition comparison cannot imply them, so B_to_A re-proves them outright by the project's constructions and does not use B. Universes at 0.
overlap: HARNESS: the banned isScSmoothMap_fibredSnd occurs in the statement of the vocabulary structure IsProperStrongBundleCovering: its field isStrongBundleIso_fibredLift has type … BW.pullback F.isScSmoothMap_fibredSnd …. So every proof that builds or destructs one reaches it through the type of .mk or of the projection, and plain #rt_check fails on both directions for that name only (recorded with #guard_msgs; #rt_check_soft does not apply, since no _proof_N is involved). Our terms otherwise avoid it, by type ascriptions with B's own smoothness proofs, resp. our fibredSnd_smooth. A local #rt_check_except_defs (harness rtCollect with the constructor, recursor and projections of IsProperStrongBundleCovering not unfolded) passes on both directions. rt_overlap B_to_A: 741 shared project theorems. These are strong-bundle/pull-back infrastructure (pullback charts, oneChart, isScSmoothMap_to_pullback(_one), isStrongBundleMap_pullbackMap, paracompactSpace_pullback) and the non-item identity lemmas (isProperCovering_id, isStrongBundleFunctor_id, isStrongBundleIsoOn_id, isScDiffeoOn_fibredMap_id) used by the copied identity construction, plus isScSmoothMap_fibredSnd through the structure's field type.
